name: undertone
description: Undertone: the conversation, without the noise. Chat bubbles with timestamps; tool calls fold into a quiet undertone, one click away.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Draw the conversation with undertone. Off = Claude Code's own look (/undertone off does it for one session).

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Preset look (see /undertone-theme for a gallery). Every setting below overrides one part of it. random picks a dark preset each time undertone loads.

bubbleStyle.title: Bubble style
bubbleStyle.description: framed = outlined bubbles; filled = solid chat-app bubbles in the theme's colours; preset = as the theme defines

userShape.title: Your bubble shape
userShape.description: rounded, sharp (square corners), double, bold, dashed, ascii (+--+), bar (left line only), none, chevron (❯ before your prompt, no frame)

userColor.title: Your bubble colour
userColor.description: Override: a theme key (suggestion, claude, success…) or hex like #4FC3F7; empty = theme

claudeColor.title: Claude bubble colour
claudeColor.description: Override: a theme key or hex; empty = theme

userFill.title: Your bubble fill
userFill.description: Background colour (theme key or hex, e.g. #1F6FEB); 'none' removes the theme's fill; empty = theme

claudeFill.title: Claude bubble fill
claudeFill.description: Background colour; 'none' removes the theme's fill; empty = theme

userTextColor.title: Your text colour
userTextColor.description: Message text colour inside your bubble; empty = theme

claudeTextColor.title: Claude text colour
claudeTextColor.description: Header text colour inside Claude's bubble; empty = theme

userLabel.title: Your label
userLabel.description: Name shown on your bubbles (e.g. Me, Joff); empty = theme

claudeLabel.title: Claude label
claudeLabel.description: Name shown on Claude's bubbles; empty = theme

userIcon.title: Your icon
userIcon.description: Shown before your label, e.g. › ● ◆ ; empty = theme

claudeIcon.title: Claude icon
claudeIcon.description: Shown before Claude's label, e.g. ✻ ◇ ; empty = theme

userAlign.title: Your bubble alignment
userAlign.description: right = chat app; left = one column like a log

dividerChar.title: Divider character
dividerChar.description: Used in day / gap dividers, e.g. ─ · ═ ≈ -; empty = theme

gapMinutes.title: Gap divider after (minutes)
gapMinutes.description: A pause this long between prompts gets a 'later' divider

timeFormat.title: Bubble time format
timeFormat.description: precise = 4:47:12.345 PM UTC+8, short = 4:47 PM, 24h = 16:47, off = no times

foldTurns.title: Keep last N turns unfolded
foldTurns.description: Older turns collapse behind [ show ]; 0 = never fold

notify.title: System notification for long turns
notify.description: OS notification (macOS, Linux notify-send, Windows toast) when a long turn finishes

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Long turn after (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: Toast + notification when a turn runs longer than this

buttons.title: Bubble buttons (☆, copy)
buttons.description: hover: hidden until the pointer is over the bubble (needs the fullscreen layout, which reports the mouse; elsewhere they show inline). inline: always shown.

tableStyle.title: Table style
tableStyle.description: How tables in Claude's replies draw, fitted to the bubble (long cells wrap inside their column). rules: a header rule and dotted lines between rows. box: a full grid. minimal: a header rule only. grid: the same as box.

quickReplies.title: Quick replies
quickReplies.description: Buttons above the prompt once Claude has answered, separated by |; one press sends it as you. off = none

dayNight.title: Light by day, dark by night
dayNight.description: Themes with a light and dark version switch by the local hour: messenger, catppuccin, gruvbox, solarized, github, rose-pine

dayHours.title: Daytime hours
dayHours.description: When the light version shows, as start-end hours (24h), e.g. 7-19

welcome.title: Welcome line
welcome.description: A line when a session starts: Good morning · 3rd session today · last one ended 2h ago

backgroundHint.title: Run-in-background hint
backgroundHint.description: The (ctrl+b to run in background) hint under a running tool. compact = ↧ ctrl+b · background, hidden, or engine = Claude Code's own

inlineImages.title: Pictures inline
inlineImages.description: Pasted PNG screenshots, and PNGs Claude reads, drawn as pictures where the terminal can (kitty, Ghostty, iTerm2 3.5+); elsewhere the chip stays

wallpaper.title: Desktop app wallpaper
wallpaper.description: A background in the theme's colours behind the conversation, in the Claude desktop app only

richText.title: Rich text
richText.description: undertone draws headings, lists and task lists, quotes and alerts, code headers and rules in Claude's replies; off = Claude Code's own drawing

headingStyle.title: Heading style
headingStyle.description: banner = a box around H1 and a heavy rule under H2; bold; underline = H1 and H2 underlined; uppercase = bold, H1 in capitals

taskStyle.title: Task list style
taskStyle.description: brackets [ ] [✓], ticks ○ ✓, box □ ✓, or progress (brackets with a done-count bar above the list)

diagramHints.title: Tell Claude about pictures
diagramHints.description: A short note only the model reads, on each prompt you type, saying this terminal draws mermaid flowcharts and charts, figures, task lists and alerts (about 130 tokens)

rtl.title: Right to left
rtl.description: auto = Hebrew and Arabic blocks right-aligned with their bullets on the right; off = left to right always

latexImages.title: Math as pictures
latexImages.description: Display math ($$…$$, ```math) typeset as a picture when ratex-render is on your PATH and the terminal draws pictures; otherwise math reads as text with symbols

colorText.title: Colour numbers and paths
colorText.description: In plain paragraphs and list items: numbers, versions, durations and percentages in amber, paths in their own colour; right-to-left text right-aligned. Text with a link stays Claude Code's own, so the link stays clickable

diffStyle.title: Diff style
diffStyle.description: How an opened edit shows its change: card = in a rounded frame headed by the file and +/- counts; full = the lines tinted across the width, no frame; marks = no tint, only + and − coloured; bar = no tint, a coloured ▌ before each changed line

clickPaths.title: Click paths in replies
clickPaths.description: A path in Claude's text (~/src/app.ts, ./out/report.md, /tmp/a.md) opens in the file viewer on a click; nothing is ever run

surfaces.title: Surfaces
surfaces.description: Where undertone draws: all, or a comma-separated list of terminal, desktop, vscode, mobile; the rest keep Claude Code's own look

listMarker.title: List bullets
listMarker.description: dots = • ◦ ▪ by depth; dash = - at every level, so a list you select pastes as Markdown

folds.title: Long replies start
folds.description: closed = folded to their first lines with [ more ]; open = whole, with [ less ]

toolRows.title: Tool rows
toolRows.description: Off = Claude Code's own tool call rows; the rest of undertone stays

toolStyle.title: Tool row style
toolStyle.description: dim = quiet rows under the reply; tree = each row hangs under Claude's sentence with ⎿; bright = full brightness, bold status dot

toolOutput.title: Tool output
toolOutput.description: full = any row opens to its output; quiet = reads, searches and read-only shell commands are one row that never opens (edits and failures still do)

runningDot.title: Running call
runningDot.description: ring = a still ◌; blink = ● on and off every half second

copyButtons.title: Copy buttons
copyButtons.description: Off hides every copy button (/undertone copy still works)

textCopyButtons.title: Copy buttons on lists and quotes
textCopyButtons.description: Off hides the copy buttons on lists, quotes and alerts and keeps the rest

mermaid.title: Draw mermaid diagrams
mermaid.description: Off leaves mermaid blocks as code (figures still draw)

mermaidAscii.title: Diagrams in ASCII
mermaidAscii.description: Draw diagrams and charts with + - | and # instead of box-drawing characters and blocks

pieStyle.title: Pie charts
pieStyle.description: bars = one bar per slice, largest first; round = a circle of coloured cells with a legend

bubbleLabels.title: Bubble labels
bubbleLabels.description: on = You / Claude over each bubble, with any icon; small = the names without icons; off = frames and times only

numberColor.title: Number colour
numberColor.description: A colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

pathColor.title: Path colour
pathColor.description: A colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

headingColor.title: Heading colour
headingColor.description: A colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

bulletColor.title: Bullet colour
bulletColor.description: A colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

diagramColor.title: Diagram colour
diagramColor.description: A colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

alertNoteColor.title: Note alert colour
alertNoteColor.description: A colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

alertTipColor.title: Tip alert colour
alertTipColor.description: A colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

alertImportantColor.title: Important alert colour
alertImportantColor.description: A colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

alertWarningColor.title: Warning alert colour
alertWarningColor.description: A colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

alertCautionColor.title: Caution alert colour
alertCautionColor.description: A colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

pngBackgroundColor.title: PNG copy background
pngBackgroundColor.description: A colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

tableHeaderColor.title: Table header colour
tableHeaderColor.description: Table header cells: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

tableRuleColor.title: Table rule colour
tableRuleColor.description: Table borders and rules: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

tableTextColor.title: Table text colour
tableTextColor.description: Plain text in table cells: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

diffAddedColor.title: Diff added colour
diffAddedColor.description: Added lines: their + marks and bars, and the count: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

diffRemovedColor.title: Diff removed colour
diffRemovedColor.description: Removed lines: their − marks and bars, and the count: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

unreadPrompts.title: Grey until read
unreadPrompts.description: Your latest prompt stays grey, with a blinking dot, until Claude starts on it

accentColor.title: Accent colour
accentColor.description: Diagram lines and figure accents (Diagram colour wins): a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

strongColor.title: Bold text colour
strongColor.description: Bold text in replies and tables: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

emphasisColor.title: Italic text colour
emphasisColor.description: Italic text in replies and tables: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

inlineCodeColor.title: Inline code colour
inlineCodeColor.description: `inline code` in replies and tables: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

linkColor.title: Link colour
linkColor.description: Links in replies and tables: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

quoteColor.title: Quote bar colour
quoteColor.description: The bar down a quote: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

ruleColor.title: Rule colour
ruleColor.description: Horizontal rules: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

diagramTextColor.title: Diagram text colour
diagramTextColor.description: Labels in diagrams and figures: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); empty = the theme's

codeTextColor.title: Code text colour
codeTextColor.description: Plain text in code blocks: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); setting any code colour makes undertone draw code blocks itself

codeCommandColor.title: Code command colour
codeCommandColor.description: Shell commands, function and class names in code blocks: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); setting any code colour makes undertone draw code blocks itself

codeFlagColor.title: Code flag colour
codeFlagColor.description: --flags and keywords in code blocks: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); setting any code colour makes undertone draw code blocks itself

codeStringColor.title: Code string colour
codeStringColor.description: Strings in code blocks: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); setting any code colour makes undertone draw code blocks itself

codeCommentColor.title: Code comment colour
codeCommentColor.description: Comments in code blocks: a colour (hex, rgb(), ansi256() or a colour name); setting any code colour makes undertone draw code blocks itself
